name: Eye Care Optics Intl LLC - RTA EYE TEST CENTER (renewal service)

reviews.author: Mohamed Shajith
reviews.text: Very friendly staff and truly great service. I went in only to change the lenses while keeping my own frame, and they handled everything with so much care and professionalism. I really appreciate the way they explained the options and made sure the fitting was perfect. Extremely happy with the result and the overall experience.

reviews.author: Vyshnav Chandhu
reviews.text: Excellent service and highly professional customer support. They are an RTA-approved eye test provider, and the entire process was smooth and well organized. The front desk staff were very friendly and even provided free cleaning service for my optical glasses, which was truly appreciated. Their professionalism and customer care exceeded my expectations. Highly recommended for anyone looking for reliable optical services and eye testing.
